Anvay is known for his commentaries on various Jaina texts, including the Agamasudhakara, Tattvartha Sutra, and the Uttarardhakamaka.

Anvay is also mentioned in the 12th century Kannada literature as the author of the Anvayamaharabharata, a commentary on the Mahabharata.
